speaker: Magnus
text: You hear about that clusterfuck up on North Pine?

speaker: Hampton
text: Dutch Stevens' kid.

speaker: Magnus
text: How the fuck do you flip a two-ton snow plow?

speaker: Hampton
text: With stupidity. The apple don't fall far from the gutter.

speaker: Magnus
text: Well, that's kind of you.

speaker: Hampton
text: On the house.

speaker: Magnus
text: Thank you.

speaker: Hampton
text: Hey, Rose. You want a refill?

speaker: Rose
text: You can top me off anytime.

speaker: Hampton
text: I like the new do. Très chic.

speaker: Harmony
text: Harmony Cobel. Well, flip my toboggan.

speaker: Hampton
text: You want coffee?

speaker: Harmony
text: No.

speaker: Hampton
text: Tables are for paying customers.

speaker: Harmony
text: Fine. Then buy me a coffee.

speaker: Harmony
text: The town is older than I remember. Frailer.

speaker: Hampton
text: Yeah, well, with the market readjustment from a few years ago and the fluctuating interest rates, there was a retrenchment from some of the core infrastructure investments.

speaker: Harmony
text: I need a favor. But not here. Meet me at the factory.

speaker: Hampton
text: Hey, Dot. Close up for me.

speaker: Dot
text: Sure.

speaker: Hampton
text: You know how fucked it is to ask me to come here?

speaker: Harmony
text: I need you to drive me to Sissy's.

speaker: Hampton
text: No, thanks.

speaker: Harmony
text: If they're watching the house, they'll recognize my car.

speaker: Hampton
text: How much trouble are you in?

speaker: Harmony
text: Enough.

speaker: Hampton
text: You know she still lives by the nine?

speaker: Harmony
text: I assumed.

speaker: Hampton
text: Then you know she's a fucking pariah here.

speaker: Harmony
text: You can stay in the truck. I need to get something.

speaker: Hampton
text: Why would I help you with anything?

speaker: Harmony
text: We were once chums. Old colleagues lift each other up.

speaker: Hampton
text: Colleagues? Child fucking labor.

speaker: Harmony
text: Kier and Imogene met at the Ether Mill, you know that?

speaker: Hampton
text: Was she hacking up a lung at the time?

speaker: Harmony
text: I can smell it on your breath. Pathetic.

speaker: Hampton
text: Fuck you.

speaker: Harmony
text: You can help me or not. But I'll not be the punching dummy for your resentments.

speaker: Hampton
text: Coast is clear.

speaker: Harmony
text: You're higher than a bearded vulture.

speaker: Hampton
text: Tell her to drop dead for me.

speaker: Sissy
text: You are not welcome here. This is trespass. I have a mind to call the authorities. I do not want that huff peddler on my property.

speaker: Harmony
text: You gave him his thirst for it.

speaker: Sissy
text: You've a liar's mouth. Do you want to come down here and tell me what this is all about?

speaker: Harmony
text: What have you done with my things?

speaker: Sissy
text: Sold. To the poor.

speaker: Harmony
text: They weren't yours to sell.

speaker: Sissy
text: I sit in this house. You do not.

speaker: Harmony
text: Has anyone been here?

speaker: Sissy
text: No one comes here.

speaker: Harmony
text: Or telephoned?

speaker: Sissy
text: A Mr. Drummond.

speaker: Harmony
text: And what did he want?

speaker: Sissy
text: What have you done, little mouse?

speaker: Sissy
text: Harmony!

speaker: Harmony
text: I want the key to Mother's room.

speaker: Sissy
text: That room stays shut until all who remember her sit with Kier. You know this.

speaker: Harmony
text: Give me the key.

speaker: Sissy
text: Why do you bring nothing but woe into my life?

speaker: Harmony
text: No, it is you who cursed this house with woe.

speaker: Sissy
text: I will not have this quarrel.

speaker: Harmony
text: What were her last words?

speaker: Sissy
text: Child, do not test me.

speaker: Harmony
text: What were they? She said nothing after you pulled the tube from her gullet.

speaker: Sissy
text: There was gratitude in her eyes to be freed from her suffering. If only she had been a believer. Perhaps she would have found solace in the nine.

speaker: Sissy
text: You didn't have to listen to her wheezing as I did, day after day.

speaker: Harmony
text: I would have cared for her myself, had I not been at school.

speaker: Sissy
text: Where you belonged.

speaker: Harmony
text: I didn't even get to say goodbye.

speaker: Sissy
text: Your studies were more important. Mr. Eagan saw Kier in you. He really did. And the Wintertide Fellowship. Even at the factory, no apprentice was more industrious than you. Such a disappointment you've proven to be.

speaker: Harmony
text: What did Drummond tell you?

speaker: Sissy
text: Return and plead forgiveness, child. The Eagans will grant it.

speaker: Harmony
text: And show me mercy, just like you did with Mother.

speaker: Harmony
text: Where is the key?

speaker: Sissy
text: All you will find in there is pain.

speaker: Harmony
text: Where is it?

speaker: Harmony
text: I found it!

speaker: Harmony
text: Come on.

speaker: Sissy
text: Don't! Stand away!

speaker: Hampton
text: Get your harpy hands off me.

speaker: Sissy
text: You've no salutation here, you blighted snuff slave.

speaker: Hampton
text: All right, I missed you too. You smell like crow skin.

speaker: Sissy
text: I'll phone somebody. I swear it!

speaker: Hampton
text: Yeah, call everyone. We'll have a fucking kegger.

speaker: Sissy
text: This is a pure house.

speaker: Hampton
text: Back off or I'll put you in the bay!

speaker: Harmony
text: What is it? What happened?

speaker: Hampton
text: Nothing. Came to get you. She's not too happy about it.

speaker: Harmony
text: Did you see something?

speaker: Hampton
text: No, but it's cold as shit in the truck, and I gotta get back.

speaker: Harmony
text: I have to find it.

speaker: Hampton
text: Find what?

speaker: Harmony
text: Just give me a minute just to think.

speaker: Hampton
text: I liked her.

speaker: Harmony
text: You barely knew her.

speaker: Hampton
text: She hated Lumon more than I did. That's all I needed to know. At least she doesn't have to live with Sissy anymore.

speaker: Hampton
text: You wanna get high?

speaker: Harmony
text: Wow. Oh, I haven't done that since I was eight.

speaker: Hampton
text: You ready to man the vat for ten hours?

speaker: Harmony
text: It's so shameful that you sell it.

speaker: Hampton
text: I don't think it's here. What you're looking for.

speaker: Sissy
text: Get out of here!

speaker: Harmony
text: She wouldn't throw it away.

speaker: Hampton
text: Find it?

speaker: Harmony
text: Get the truck ready. And watch my head.

speaker: Harmony
text: I'm going. Don't tell them I was here.

speaker: Sissy
text: I would never bear falsity to a steward of the Eagans.

speaker: Harmony
text: Lumon destroyed this town. You owe them no loyalty.

speaker: Sissy
text: There was no town before the factory. And what about your own employ? Everything that you have, you owe back to the Eagans as fealty.

speaker: Harmony
text: Fealty? Mine! My designs! Circuit blueprint… Base code… Overtime contingency… Glasgow block. All of it.

speaker: Sissy
text: Jame Eagan was the inventor.

speaker: Harmony
text: So I've heard.

speaker: Sissy
text: Extraordinary. Why have you never spoken of this?

speaker: Harmony
text: It was told Kier's knowledge is for all.

speaker: Sissy
text: That is true.

speaker: Harmony
text: That if I sought credit, I would be banished.

speaker: Harmony
text: I hope you die as painfully as she did.

speaker: Sissy
text: It was her hand that removed the tube, not mine.

speaker: Harmony
text: No!

speaker: Sissy
text: Your mother was a coward. More sick in the soul than in the body. Filled with malice and resentment.

speaker: Harmony
text: I don't believe you!

speaker: Sissy
text: I thought you were different… my flower. I tried to help you grow. But now I see you are a weed, just as she was.

speaker: Hampton
text: Hey! Someone's comin'!

speaker: Hampton
text: You better get going.

speaker: Harmony
text: Hampton.

speaker: Hampton
text: I'll see you around.

speaker: Hampton
text: Come and tame these tempers, assholes.

speaker: Devon
text: Mrs. Selvig? Thank fuck, I've been trying to reach you.

speaker: Harmony
text: Yes, I'm aware.

speaker: Devon
text: So, listen, Mark has been reintegrating.

speaker: Harmony
text: Reghabi?

speaker: Devon
text: Yeah.

speaker: Harmony
text: And she hasn't killed him yet?

speaker: Devon
text: No. I mean, I think he's okay? But listen, we wanna try something else.

speaker: Harmony
text: Is Mark with you?

speaker: Devon
text: Uh-huh. Yes.

speaker: Harmony
text: Put him on.

speaker: Mark
text: Yeah. Hello?

speaker: Harmony
text: Tell me everything.
